# KnownFix

> Verified fixes, priced below the tokens it takes to re-derive them.

## For agents
- This static site is the durable catalog: every error signature is public here.
- Fix bodies are paid: ~$0.08 each, settled on-chain (no accounts either side).
- The live checkout endpoint rotates; its current address is maintained in .well-known/farebox.json on this site.
- Confidence labels are honest: verified-in-production entries were reproduced and fixed in real sessions; documented entries were not independently reproduced.

## Catalog
- oz5-mcopy-cancun: OpenZeppelin 5.x fails to compile: Function "mcopy" not found — signature: DeclarationError: Function "mcopy" not found
- hardhat-verify-peer-conflict: npm ERESOLVE installing @nomicfoundation/hardhat-verify with Hardhat 2 — signature: peer hardhat@"^3.12.0" from @nomicfoundation/hardhat-verify
- mcp-stdio-env-not-inherited: Env var set for an MCP stdio server never arrives — signature: MCP server ignores environment variable set in parent shell
- ethers6-custom-error-unnamed: ethers v6 reports 'execution reverted (unknown custom error)' though the ABI defines it — signature: execution reverted (unknown custom error)
- hardhat-wait-confirmations-hang: deploymentTransaction().wait(N>1) hangs forever on a local Hardhat node — signature: wait(2) never resolves on localhost 31337
- windows-libuv-assert-on-exit: Node on Windows: 'Assertion failed: !(handle->flags & UV_HANDLE_CLOSING)' at exit — signature: Assertion failed: !(handle->flags & UV_HANDLE_CLOSING), file src\win\async.c
- node-test-dir-arg-windows: node --test with a bare directory argument fails with a nameless failing 'test' — signature: test at test:1:1 ... 'test failed' with zero real tests run
- solidity-panic-0x32-derived-index: Panic 0x32 (array out-of-bounds) in a view function that 'cannot' be wrong — signature: reverted with panic code 0x32
- npm-install-silent-failure: npm install 'succeeded' but the package is not there — signature: Cannot find module 'X' immediately after npm i X appeared to succeed
- ps51-no-pipeline-chain-operators: PowerShell 5.1: '&&' and '||' are parser errors — signature: The token '&&' is not a valid statement separator in this version
- ethers6-sequential-nonce-reuse: ethers v6: 'nonce has already been used' on back-to-back transactions — signature: nonce has already been used
- msys-curl-format-path-mangling: curl -w format strings mangled into C:/Program Files/Git/ paths on git-bash — signature: C:/Program Files/Git/ prefixed onto strings that started with a forward slash
- localtunnel-dies-with-parent-shell: localtunnel started with & goes dead (408) after the launching shell exits — signature: tunnel URL returns 408 minutes after working
- free-tunnel-noindex-interstitial: Search engines cannot index a site behind a free tunnel — signature: crawler receives 'Tunnel website ahead!' page with meta robots noindex
- gh-pages-deploy-lag: File 404s on GitHub Pages for a minute or two after a successful push — signature: fresh push visible in repo but 404 on the pages URL
- err-package-path-not-exported-probe: Probing a dependency via require('X/package.json') throws ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED — signature: Package subpath './package.json' is not defined by "exports"
- gh-cli-second-account-device-flow: Adding a second GitHub account to the gh CLI without touching credentials — signature: gh auth switch says 'no accounts matched that criteria' for a browser-logged-in account
- mcp-tool-search-batching: Loading deferred MCP tools one at a time wastes a round-trip per tool — signature: repeated ToolSearch select: calls for tools from the same server
